user.title: Connect to ATEM
user.description: The switcher must be reachable on the network. Audio meters are sampled down from the switcher's 10 Hz Fairlight stream.

error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the ATEM handshake. Check the IP, that the switcher is on, and that port 9910/UDP is open.
error.fully_booked: The switcher refused the connection because too many control clients are already connected.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP and a valid port.
